  PUBLIC COMMENT

  Marisa  Olguin,  Vemon  Chamber  of Commerce.  referenced  the LA  Times  article  regarding

  the  Mayrvood  City Council  charged  with taking  bribes  and  misusing  public  funds;

  recall effort.
